note.question: When is experiential retailing the common practice in the market, it enables “win-win-win” outcomes when free experiences fail?
note.overview: In an environment where consumers’ rising valuation of Instagrammable memories drives their spending from products to experiences, retailers offer experiences to attract consumers back to their stores. Yet, it is not obvious under which settings consumers can benefit from these experiences and raise retailers’ profits. We use a random utility model for consumer choice in both monopoly and duopoly settings.
